title: Two steps, two discounts
hook: A reward stays the same while its weight changes.

knows: Small arithmetic and the prerequisites listed below.
doesNotKnow: gamma is applied once per elapsed transition; a reward two steps away gets gamma², not one copy of gamma. Distinct from the already briefed value-vs-reward: focus on time weights across one fixed reward stream rather than choosing between actions.

misconception: gamma is applied once per elapsed transition; a reward two steps away gets gamma², not one copy of gamma. Distinct from the already briefed value-vs-reward: focus on time weights across one fixed reward stream rather than choosing between actions.

claims.text: A finite return weights reward at time t by gamma^t, beginning t0. For[0,2,4],gamma.5 gives weights[1,.5,.25],contributions[0,1,1],total2;gamma0 gives0;gamma1 gives6. Outlines show raw rewards, narrow filled bars show contributions. Changed[1,0,8] returns3 atgamma.5 and1.5 atgamma.25.

claims.text: Title: Two steps, two discounts Hook: A reward stays the same while its weight changes. A reward one step ahead counts half. How much does reward 4 contribute when it is two steps ahead? Options: 1 / 2 / 4; answer 0.
claims.source: Local model.ts and model.repro.mjs; https://www.gatsby.ucl.ac.uk/~dayan/papers/cjch.pdf (discounted-return framework in original Q-learning paper; exact finite indexing derived locally), opened2026-10-19 for method context, not verification of toy outputs.
claims.address: meta.json title/hook; Demo.tsx predict question/options and locked fixture

claims.text: In the retained stream, rewards 0, 2, 4 contribute 0, 1, 1 when the discount is one half. The later reward is weighted twice: its multiplier is one quarter. Changing the discount changes these weights, not the raw rewards. The first transition has weight one.
claims.source: Local model.ts and model.repro.mjs; https://www.gatsby.ucl.ac.uk/~dayan/papers/cjch.pdf (discounted-return framework in original Q-learning paper; exact finite indexing derived locally), opened2026-10-19 for method context, not verification of toy outputs.
claims.address: Demo.tsx reveal and retained original-case witness

claims.text: Rewards at times 0, 1, 2 are 1, 0, 8. At discount one half, what is their return? The first reward contributes 1; the last contributes 8 times one quarter, or 2. Total return is 3.
claims.source: Local model.ts and model.repro.mjs; https://www.gatsby.ucl.ac.uk/~dayan/papers/cjch.pdf (discounted-return framework in original Q-learning paper; exact finite indexing derived locally), opened2026-10-19 for method context, not verification of toy outputs.
